articles.title: Virginia is the worst region for on-time mail delivery
articles.body:
RICHMOND, Va. (WRIC) — The United States Postal Service (USPS) has ranked Virginia the worst region in the U.S. for on-time mail delivery, says the Office of the Inspector General.

According to the office’s latest Service Performance report, Virginia is now USPS’ lowest-ranked region for percentage of parcels delivered on time with 74.9% — 12.1 percentage points below the national average of 84.1%.

It is the second time the commonwealth ranked last in on-time deliveries since 2024 with 66.1%.
